label: conj:jet-filtered-knot-factor
title: Jet-filtered knot factor: per-level character convergence and nuclear quotient braid
html:
Conjecture. The Bethe-Weizsäcker knot factor a(Z, N) governing bulk binding evaluates directly from the jet-filtered character convergence of the nuclear quotient braid \bar\beta.

At higher jet levels, the per-level invariant converges strictly to a topology-independent q-dimension-weighted average. The intermediate nucleon-by-nucleon normal forms align with distinct knot patterns, mapping odd Z to trefoils and even Z to Hopf links. Double-magic nuclei converge strongly to the unknot.

The full bulk knot factor a(Z, N) equals the evaluated Jones polynomial of the nuclear quotient braid J_{\bar\beta}(q). The quotient tracks exclusively the A(A-1)/2 inter-nucleon crossings, suppressing internal nucleon structure.

Measured: J_{\bar\beta} is not determined by the pair multiset for A \ge 3

The conjecture identifies a(Z,N) with the Jones polynomial of the nuclear quotient braid, and specifies that braid by its content — "the A(A-1)/2 inter-nucleon crossings". That is a multiset; a link needs a word, and the non-adjacent pairs require bands that do not commute with the crossings they span. Enumerating every ordering of the pairs, and both resolutions of the averaged pn letter (which is not a braid generator and must be resolved):

nucleus A orderings distinct J_{\bar\beta}
^3H 3 12 4
^3He 3 12 4
^4He 4 1440 30

So a(Z,N) as written is not a function of (Z,N). This is the same ill-posedness that retired the all-pairs bond model (the ordering ambiguity), measured here on the quotient braid itself rather than inherited from the 3A-strand word.

At A = 2 the specification is well posed — A(A-1)/2 = A-1 = 1, so there is one crossing on two strands and no ordering to choose — and its closure is the unknot for every bond type and both resolutions. The jet level therefore multiplies the deuteron's knot factor by exactly 1: where it can be evaluated, it contributes nothing.

Nothing here retracts the conjecture. It says what a reformulation must supply: a rule fixing the word, not just its crossing content. the_nuclear_jet_level_is_the_retired_all_pairs_object_probe.py.
